title: No Snowgolem Grief
description: Snowgolems no longer spawn snow trails
body:
Are snowgolems ruining your builds by just walking around, or tired of super easy to set up infinite snow farms? This lightweight server side mod fixes these issues entirely by not allowing snow golems to create a snow trail in the first place.

![Snowgolem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/I2zfWAvU/images/21103251ebc2bf9804815e25337f5e6e8bd5bfde.png)
